value: "v5 API: instruments-info, funding/history, kline, mark-price-kline, index-price-kline all public/keyless. public.bybit.com hosts daily trading (trade) and kline zip archives per symbol going back to each symbol's listing; folder-per-symbol layout persists for delisted symbols (tested LUNAUSDT). Historical funding via v5 API is generally capped to a limited lookback window per call (paginated by startTime/endTime, cursor); full history reconstruction requires iterating."
"keyless (static historical downloads at okx.com + public REST /api/v5/public,market)"

"OKX REST public endpoints (market/instruments, public/funding-rate-history, market/history-candles, market/index-candles, market/mark-price-candles) are keyless. funding-rate-history and funding-rate-history endpoints only return a limited recent window per call and OKX does not appear to expose a full historical bulk-download portal equivalent to Binance's data.vision for perp klines; OKX also purges/renames instruments on delisting so historical delisted instIds may 404 on the live instruments endpoint (survivorship risk) even though history endpoints can sometimes still be queried by instId for a bounded lookback."
"keyless (public JSON-RPC/REST API at deribit.com; history.deribit.com UI)"

"Deribit public JSON-RPC API (get_instruments with expired=true, get_funding_rate_history, get_tradingview_chart_data for klines, get_index_price, get_historical_volatility) is fully keyless and retains expired/delisted instruments in get_instruments(expired=true), including creation/expiration timestamps -- good delisting discoverability. Deribit is primarily an options/futures venue; BTC-PERPETUAL and ETH-PERPETUAL are the main perps (funding settles hourly, not 8h). history.deribit.com is a human-facing statistics UI, not a bulk file archive."
"keyless (public REST /api/v1, plus public S3 trade/quote archives at s3.amazonaws.com/public.bitmex.com)"

"BitMEX public REST API (instrument, funding, trade, quote, orderBookL2, instrument?filter=state:Settled) is keyless with no auth required for read-only market data. Public S3 archive s3.amazonaws.com/public.bitmex.com/data/{trade,quote}/YYYYMMDD.csv.gz goes back to 2014-11-22 (BitMEX launch) and is a true survivor-free tick-level daily archive since it is organized by calendar day, not by currently-listed symbol. instrument?filter={state:Settled/Unlisted} enumerates delisted/expired contracts. BitMEX historically listed dated futures (e.g. XBTZ22) and a small number of altcoin perps; LUNA/FTT were never listed on BitMEX (verify via instrument search) so those exact symbols are not a valid survivorship test here -- use BitMEX's own delisted symbols (e.g. XRPZ22-style dated futures, or ADAH19) instead."

"Kraken Futures public REST (instruments, historicalfundingrates, api/charts candles, api/history/v3/market-history for trades) is keyless. The live /instruments endpoint only lists currently-tradeable contracts (no obvious flag to list delisted ones), so survivorship must be assessed via the separate history/market-history endpoints per known symbol or via Kraken's public download page (support.kraken.com futures historical data CSVs), not from a single enumerable delisted-list endpoint."
"keyless (public info API POST at api.hyperliquid.xyz/info; historical fills via S3-backed node data)"

"Hyperliquid /info POST endpoint (meta, fundingHistory, candleSnapshot, metaAndAssetCtxs) is keyless. Mainnet launched 2023-05, so there is no pre-2020 sample and no 2020-2022 sample at all; it cannot serve as a LUNA/FTX-era survivorship test. Delisted perps (Hyperliquid has delisted some low-volume perps) drop out of the 'meta' universe response, so a survivor-free perp list requires the historical asset-index mapping preserved in fundingHistory/candleSnapshot by coin name, not a single delisted-list endpoint. Node-level historical fills/L2 book data is distributed via a requester-pays AWS S3 bucket (hyperliquid-archive), not a free public HTTP index; out of scope for a keyless, no-account probe."

"dYdX v4 (Cosmos appchain, launched 2023-10) indexer REST API (perpetualMarkets, historicalFunding, candles, trades) is keyless. dYdX v3 (StarkEx L2, 2021-2023) used a different, now-deprecated API (api.dydx.exchange) that has been shut down following the v4 migration, so v3 history is not reliably queryable via a live keyless endpoint any more -- a gap for a pre-2023 dYdX sample. v4 cannot serve a 2020-2022 survivorship test (chain did not exist). Delisted v4 markets: perpetualMarkets response includes a 'status' field (ACTIVE/DELISTED/etc.) enabling in-band survivorship discovery per market."
